summary: Full backend + frontend testing of the new AI-cost feature (custo de IA por peça/refação/etapa). All requested flows PASS end-to-end. 9/9 backend pytest tests green; all frontend testids exist and function as spec'd.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py list_pieces: only computes billable_brl in-memory (not persisted). Fine since it uses current pricing at read-time — this is actually the correct behavior when the user changes markup later. No action.

generator-costs panel is shown only when costs.total > 0 (via Generator.jsx). Verified in E2E: appears after first text gen with 'Copy (texto)' line, and shows 'Refação de texto' after second gen with same gen_group_id — matches spec.

cost_report groups costs even before the piece is saved (piece_id may be None). Rows counting distinct pieces via set(); pieces count may under-count until save-piece binds gen_group -> piece_id. Non-blocking, but worth noting: the reports 'Peças' column can lag between generation and save.
test_credentials: Admin: jussaracavalcante25@gmail.com / Vanguarda@2026 (cookie-based auth: /api/auth/login sets access_token httpOnly cookie — NO bearer token returned in body).
seed_data_creation: One text piece created + deleted by backend test cleanup; one additional piece created via Playwright save-piece flow (title auto-generated, has cost_brl≈R$0.03, refacao_texto stage, gpt-5.4-mini + claude-sonnet-4-6). Left in DB intentionally so main agent can visually verify chip and review-costs modal.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth is COOKIE-BASED (httpOnly access_token, session_token). Use requests.Session() and login via POST /api/auth/login — do NOT expect a bearer token in the response body (login returns user info only). Cost feature verified: POST /api/pieces/generate SSE final event shape is {done:true, stage, cost_brl, tokens}; same gen_group_id twice yields stage='refacao_texto' on 2nd. PUT /api/settings {pricing:{markup_pct:X}} persists and GET /api/settings returns merged pricing with defaults (usd_to_brl=5.4, markup_pct=100, image_high_per_unit=0.19, models gpt-5.4-mini/claude-sonnet-4-6). Piece types are: post_instagram, stories, anuncio_meta, anuncio_linkedin, email_marketing, blog (NOT 'instagram_post'). Frontend routes PT-BR (/gerar /pecas /custos /configuracoes). Pieces list only shows piece-cost-<id> chip on pieces WITH cost_brl (older pieces without it show no chip — correct). Review-costs modal is opened by clicking 'Revisar peça' link, not the cost chip. Recharts throws harmless 'width(-1) height(-1)' console warnings on dashboard — not a bug.

frontend./pecas: piece-cost-<id> chip visible on: PASS (1 chip on the piece with cost)
